label: OFFLINE SERVER PERCEPTION AND PRIVATE MAP RECORD VALIDATION
scope: Source-level deterministic server tests; no compiled-browser or real-model acceptance is claimed here.

historicalFailure.finding: The fifth real attempt completed Cargo and one confirmed Gallery move, then the current-emblem question received no observation call or emblem. This remains a failed full Rescue with acknowledged termination.

observed: Existing successful Gallery move prose already contained the reached emblem and adjacent gates.
Four new cases failed because the corresponding typed scoped perception was absent.
Relay Beacon -> Harbor -> Beacon left the old pending proposal executable, contradicting the requested stale-proposal policy.
before.testAuthoringNote: An initial test-helper envelope incorrectly included chapterEpoch in the exact decision schema. It was corrected before the five meaningful baseline failures; that authoring error is not a product finding.

runs.command: GAME_DISABLE_LIVE=1 node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs --test tests/records.test.ts tests/rescue-state.test.ts tests/rescue-http.test.ts tests/state.test.ts
runs.note: The two remaining failures were exact expected empty annotation shapes at reset. The prior five contract assertion differences were migrated without relaxing authority/privacy checks.

runs.command: GAME_DISABLE_LIVE=1 node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs --test --test-name-pattern="annotations and hints|chapter-aware records retain" tests/rescue-state.test.ts tests/rescue-http.test.ts
runs.note: Both remaining reset-shape assertions passed after adding the new empty private fields; one existing generation check also matched the name filter.

contractMigrations: Empty annotation projections now include plannedGates, exploredGates and reportLinks.
Hidden-layout comparison equalizes opaque scope identities and clock, then still deep-compares the complete local projection.
A changed Relay now invalidates the exact old proposal, with a truthful no-execution reason.

coverage: Actual arrival survey projected once as typed robot-local facts; Cargo entry and intra-Gallery arrival.
Round/chapter/opaque visit/observation/state/action revisions and server time; return visits get distinct IDs.
Survey passages remain unchecked; explicit local inspection distinguishes open blocked and closed clear in both layouts.
Proposed, declined, expired, failed, duplicate, canceled and departed cases do not create new destination surveys.
Pause and chapter transition prevent old surveys from being current; committed action history remains accessible.
Only the current stored perception is re-exposed by action-status queries; historical prose is labelled historical.
HumanView, public proposal, decision caption and ordinary records exclude local perception.
Private intended/explored routes and exact report associations stay out of robot recap; delayed pinning and Relay toggles cannot revive dynamic report freshness.
Quick-request input records preserve non-microphone human provenance.
limitations: No new real-provider call, full candidate build or browser validation was performed by this server subtask.
Provider comprehension and arrival wording require separate runtime/browser and real-attempt evidence.
Controller context on communicated reports describes server record receipt and historical invalidation; it is not independent verification that spoken claims were true.
Cached original decision responses remain immutable historical receipts; the client must reject delayed perception using scope/revision and connection guards.
